name: Sol
description: Humanity's cradle. Crowded lanes, old money, and every rumor of what lies past the Oort Cloud.

bodies.name: Earth
bodies.description: Blue, loud, and expensive. Every captain's story starts or ends here.

sites.name: New Geneva Spaceport
sites.description: The busiest port in human space: customs queues, glass towers, and contracts signed over lunch.

notes.trade: Commodity exchange — prices set by half the colonies.
notes.missions: Contract hall — corporate couriers and government charters.
notes.bar: The Departure Lounge — overpriced, and everyone who matters drinks there.

sites.name: Lagos Skyport
sites.description: A sprawling freight port where crews swap cargo, gossip, and favors at all hours.

notes.trade: Freight market — haggling encouraged.
notes.bar: Mama Ade's — cheap stew, good tips on who's hiring.

sites.name: The Sump
sites.description: The crowded levels under New Geneva: noodle stalls, data dens, and favors traded faster than credits.

notes.trade: Everything is for sale down here, and half of it fell off a freighter.
notes.bar: A data den with cheap drinks, fast connections and people who never give their real names.

bodies.name: Luna
bodies.description: Earth's moon: old landing sites under glass, and a university that trains half the pilots in Sol.

sites.name: Tranquility Base
sites.description: A preserved landing site wrapped in a pilot academy. Cadets salute anyone with their own ship.

notes.missions: Academy board — test flights and odd jobs for licensed captains.

bodies.name: Highport
bodies.description: Earth's orbital gateway. Cargo cranes, dry docks, and a bar that never closes.

sites.name: Highport Docks
sites.description: Ring-shaped dry docks where most of Sol's ships are refit.

notes.repair: Dry dock — patched hulls while you wait.
notes.drydock: Highport Yards — the best-equipped dry docks in Sol, if you can afford the berth.

bodies.name: Mars
bodies.description: Domed cities and shipyards under a rust-red sky. Mars builds the hulls Earth pays for.

sites.name: Olympus Yards
sites.description: Launch rails up the flank of Olympus Mons, and the loudest engineers in Sol.

notes.drydock: Martian engineers who'll rebuild your engines and argue with you the whole time.

sites.name: Valles Commons
sites.description: A canyon city of terraced domes, where water rights decide elections.

notes.trade: Water and ore exchange.
notes.missions: Canyon Council postings — survey runs and escorts.
notes.bar: The Dust Devil — miners, mechanics, and arguments.

bodies.name: Jupiter
bodies.description: A gas giant. Too deep a gravity well to land, but its moons are busy.

bodies.name: Europa
bodies.description: An ice moon with an ocean underneath, and scientists who won't say what they found.

sites.name: Europa Deep Station
sites.description: A drilling station perched over the ice, staffed by researchers who rarely see visitors.

notes.missions: Research grants — sample runs and quiet deliveries.

name: Alpha Centauri
description: The first colony system. Twin suns, frontier pride, and the busiest shipyard outside Sol.

bodies.name: Proxima b
bodies.description: A tidally locked world orbiting Proxima, the system's red dwarf. Life clings to the twilight band.

sites.name: Terminator City
sites.description: Built along the narrow twilight ring between frozen night and burning day. Proud, cramped, and fiercely independent.

notes.trade: Twilight Market — Centauri goods, Sol prices.
notes.missions: Colonial Office — the colony needs pilots and isn't shy about it.
notes.bar: The Long Dusk — toasts to the first ships, every night.

sites.name: Darkside Camp
sites.description: Ice miners on the frozen night side. They work in shifts and sleep in their suits.

notes.trade: Ice and volatiles by the ton.
notes.bar: The Heat Lamp — one room, always full.

bodies.name: Centauri Yards
bodies.description: The largest shipyard outside Sol, hanging between the twin suns.

sites.name: Yard Ring
sites.description: Endless construction scaffolds and a waiting list for berths.

notes.drydock: Centauri Yards — frontier craftsmanship, and a waiting list they'll skip for cash.

name: Barnard's Star
description: A dim, ancient red dwarf. Quiet, cheap, and popular with people who prefer not to be noticed.

bodies.name: Barnard's Star b
bodies.description: A small, hot rock orbiting close to its dim star. Nobody lives here on purpose.

bodies.name: Barnard Waystation
bodies.description: Fuel, food, and no questions. The log has more blank entries than names.

sites.name: The Ring
sites.description: A creaky trading ring where cargo changes hands without paperwork.

notes.trade: No-questions market — some of it is even legal.
notes.bar: The Blank Page — nobody signs the guestbook.

bodies.name: Halcyon Array
bodies.description: A listening post: a ring of dishes around a small habitat, all turned outward.

sites.name: Halcyon listening post
sites.description: A research habitat ringed by dishes that never stop turning. One window is lit.
sites.emptyNote: The dishes turn. The habitat hums. Someone has left the lights on in the galley.

name: Wolf 359
description: A flare-prone red dwarf. Miners come for the ore and leave before the next storm.

bodies.name: Cinder
bodies.description: A scorched rock baked by stellar flares. Rich ore under the crust.

sites.name: Cinder Pits
sites.description: Strip mines and shielded bunkers. When the flare sirens sound, everyone runs.

notes.trade: Ore by the ton, sold fast before the next flare.
notes.missions: Shift boss — haul ore out before the storm.

sites.name: Tallis Camp
sites.description: A mining camp in a crater on the night side. Silent since spring. Every light is still on.
sites.emptyNote: No one answers your hails. The airlock cycles open anyway.

bodies.name: Wolf Point
bodies.description: A shielded mining hub. Its crews measure time in flares survived.

sites.name: Wolf Point
sites.description: Heavy shielding, low ceilings, and the best ore prices this side of Sol.

notes.bar: Storm Shelter Bar — stays open through every flare.

name: Lalande 21185
description: A bright red dwarf with two known planets and a scattering of research claims.

bodies.name: Lalande 21185 b
bodies.description: A rocky world with a thin, cold atmosphere. Survey beacons blink across its plains.

sites.name: Survey Camp Seven
sites.description: Prefab domes and a dozen surveyors who are very glad to see a new face.

notes.missions: Survey contracts — beacons to place, data to recover.

bodies.name: Lalande 21185 c
bodies.description: A cold giant in a wide orbit. No landing sites.

name: Sirius
description: A blinding white star with a white-dwarf companion and corporate money in every orbit.

bodies.name: Sirius Gate
bodies.description: A polished corporate hub. Everything is for sale, and everything is watched.

sites.name: The Concourse
sites.description: Marble floors, holo-ads, and security drones that know your name before you do.

notes.trade: Corporate exchange — fixed prices, no haggling.
notes.drydock: Sirius Dynamics refit bay — premium parts, premium prices, spotless work.

sites.name: Underdeck
sites.description: Below the concourse: maintenance tunnels, back-room deals, and people the corporations would rather forget.

notes.bar: The Drain — the only honest bar on the station.
notes.missions: Quiet work, paid in cash.

bodies.name: Sirius B
bodies.description: A white dwarf: a dead star's core, hot enough to blister hulls that get too close.

name: Luyten 726-8
description: A pair of flare stars, one of them the infamous UV Ceti. Nothing lives here but a fuel depot.

bodies.name: Luyten 726-8 Waystation
bodies.description: An automated waystation kept by the Lanes Authority: a dock, a message board, and a long log of passing ships.

sites.name: Waystation Dock
sites.description: A quiet automated dock. Someone has scratched names and dates into the bulkhead — captains who passed through, some of them long ago.

name: Ross 154
description: A young, restless red dwarf. A relay point on the way to the far lanes.

bodies.name: Ross 154 Waystation
bodies.description: An automated waystation kept by the Lanes Authority: a dock, a message board, and a long log of passing ships.

sites.name: Waystation Dock
sites.description: A quiet automated dock. Someone has scratched names and dates into the bulkhead — captains who passed through, some of them long ago.

name: Ross 248
description: A small red dwarf drifting toward Sol. In forty thousand years it will be the nearest star.

bodies.name: Ross 248 Waystation
bodies.description: An automated waystation with a hand-painted sign: 'Closest star someday. Be patient.'

sites.name: Waystation Dock
sites.description: A quiet automated dock. Someone has scratched names and dates into the bulkhead — captains who passed through, some of them long ago.

name: Epsilon Eridani
description: A young orange star wrapped in dust belts and comet traffic. A crossroads of the southern lanes.

bodies.name: Epsilon Eridani b
bodies.description: A gas giant on a wide orbit, shepherding the inner dust belt.

bodies.name: Belt Haven
bodies.description: A station hollowed out of an asteroid in the inner belt.

sites.name: Haven Core
sites.description: Tunnels carved from rock, lit by grow-lamps. The belters are polite, wary, and armed.

notes.trade: Belter exchange — metals, ice, and rare finds.
notes.bar: The Drift — darts, debts, and old songs.

sites.name: Claims Office
sites.description: A cramped office where prospectors register claims and argue over borders.

notes.missions: Claim disputes, survey runs, and the occasional rescue.

name: Lacaille 9352
description: A bright red dwarf moving fast across the sky, with super-Earths in tight orbits.

bodies.name: Lacaille 9352 b
bodies.description: A heavy super-Earth with crushing gravity. Only the stubborn settle here.

sites.name: Gravity Well
sites.description: Low buildings, strong people, and a landing pad rated for very sturdy ships.

notes.trade: Heavy metals and stubbornness.
notes.missions: Haulage — someone has to lift cargo out of this well.

name: Ross 128
description: A quiet, old red dwarf with a temperate planet. Home to a small, patient colony.

bodies.name: Ross 128 b
bodies.description: A temperate world under a calm red sun. Farms in the twilight, observatories on the ridges.

sites.name: Quiet Harbor
sites.description: A farming town that talks slowly and builds things to last.

notes.trade: Farm goods, preserved and packed for long voyages.
notes.bar: The Slow Sun — homebrew and long stories.

sites.name: Ridge Observatory
sites.description: Telescopes pointed outward. The astronomers here are listening for something.

notes.missions: Sensor runs past the edge of the map.

name: Procyon
description: A bright yellow-white star and its white-dwarf companion. Rich, sunny, and expensive.

bodies.name: Procyon Exchange
bodies.description: A trading station built for bulk cargo and bigger profits.

sites.name: Trading Floor
sites.description: A cavernous hall of cargo screens and shouting brokers.

notes.trade: Bulk exchange — the best prices are for full holds.
notes.missions: Freight contracts across the eastern lanes.

name: 61 Cygni
description: Twin orange dwarfs circling each other. The first star ever measured — and a haven for scholars.

bodies.name: Bessel Archive
bodies.description: A library station named for the astronomer who first measured the distance to a star.

sites.name: Archive Halls
sites.description: Quiet halls of records from every colony. Archivists trade in secrets, not credits.

notes.missions: Recover lost records — from wrecks, ruins, and stubborn people.

sites.name: Scholars' Commons
sites.description: A cafe-and-dormitory deck where students argue about everything.

notes.bar: The Parallax — cheap tea, expensive debates.
notes.trade: Rare books, data cores, and instruments.

name: Groombridge 34
description: A red dwarf pair with a known super-Earth. A sleepy stop on the northern lanes.

bodies.name: Groombridge 34 Ab
bodies.description: A hot super-Earth. No settlement, but the views are spectacular.

bodies.name: Groombridge 34 Waystation
bodies.description: An automated waystation kept by the Lanes Authority: a dock, a message board, and a long log of passing ships.

sites.name: Waystation Dock
sites.description: A quiet automated dock. Someone has scratched names and dates into the bulkhead — captains who passed through, some of them long ago.

name: Epsilon Indi
description: An orange star with a giant planet and two brown dwarfs. A frontier mining claim.

bodies.name: Epsilon Indi Ab
bodies.description: A cold Jupiter-sized giant. Its moons are rich in ice.

bodies.name: Indi Outpost
bodies.description: A frontier outpost run by a mining cooperative.

sites.name: The Co-op
sites.description: Everyone owns a share, everyone gets a vote, and the votes are loud.

notes.trade: Co-op store — ice, ore, and fair prices.
notes.missions: Co-op jobs — escort the ore haulers.

name: Tau Ceti
description: A calm Sun-like star and a garden world. Farmers, pilgrims, and smugglers hiding among them.

bodies.name: Tau Ceti e
bodies.description: A warm, green world under a gentle sun. Its fields feed half the inner colonies.

sites.name: Verdance
sites.description: A garden city of terraces and markets. Everything smells like rain.

notes.trade: Harvest market — food for the colonies.
notes.missions: Growers' Guild — fast freight before the harvest spoils.
notes.bar: The Orchard — cider, music, and pilgrims.

sites.name: Pilgrim's Field
sites.description: A simple landing field beside a monastery. The monks don't ask what's in your hold.

notes.missions: Pilgrim passage — carry the faithful, no questions.

bodies.name: Tau Ceti f
bodies.description: A cold world at the edge of the habitable zone. Frozen seas, and one stubborn research team.

sites.name: Frostline
sites.description: A research base buried in the ice.

notes.missions: Supply runs to the ice.

name: Gliese 1061
description: A small red dwarf with three tight planets. One sits in the habitable zone.

bodies.name: Gliese 1061 d
bodies.description: A temperate rock with a thin atmosphere. A frontier homestead clings on.

sites.name: Homestead
sites.description: Six families, one landing pad, and a lot of hope.

notes.trade: Homestead store — they need everything and sell a little.

name: Luyten's Star
description: A red dwarf with a super-Earth in the habitable zone, a short hop from Procyon.

bodies.name: Luyten b
bodies.description: A cool super-Earth with deep oceans and stormy skies.

sites.name: Stormwall
sites.description: A sea-wall town built against storms that never stop.

notes.trade: Fish, salt, and storm-glass.
notes.bar: The Breakwater — loud when the storms are loudest.

name: Teegarden's Star
description: A tiny, dim red dwarf with two Earth-sized planets. One of the most Earth-like places known.

bodies.name: Teegarden's Star b
bodies.description: Nearly Earth-sized and temperate. A young colony is betting everything on it.

sites.name: Second Chance
sites.description: A new colony of people who left everything behind. They're building fast and trusting slowly.

notes.trade: Colony supply exchange — they pay well for tools.
notes.missions: Colony charter — supplies, settlers, and protection.
notes.bar: First Light — the colony's only bar, opened last month.

bodies.name: Teegarden's Star c
bodies.description: A colder sibling world. Unsettled, for now.

name: Kapteyn's Star
description: An ancient star from the galaxy's halo, older than the Sun by billions of years.

bodies.name: Kapteyn b
bodies.description: An old world around an old star. Something built here, long ago.

sites.name: The Old Site
sites.description: Weathered structures no human built. A small research team keeps watch.

notes.missions: Excavation support — and questions nobody can answer yet.

bodies.name: Kapteyn Waystation
bodies.description: An automated waystation kept by the Lanes Authority: a dock, a message board, and a long log of passing ships.

sites.name: Waystation Dock
sites.description: A quiet automated dock. Someone has scratched names and dates into the bulkhead — captains who passed through, some of them long ago.

name: Kruger 60
description: Two red dwarfs locked in a 44-year dance. A popular waypoint in the northern lanes.

bodies.name: Kruger 60 Waystation
bodies.description: An automated waystation kept by the Lanes Authority: a dock, a message board, and a long log of passing ships.

sites.name: Waystation Dock
sites.description: A quiet automated dock. Someone has scratched names and dates into the bulkhead — captains who passed through, some of them long ago.

name: Wolf 1061
description: A red dwarf with a super-Earth at the inner edge of the habitable zone. The far end of the western lanes.

bodies.name: Wolf 1061 c
bodies.description: A warm super-Earth with long, harsh days.

sites.name: Sunward Station
sites.description: A sun-shielded outpost on the edge of the western lanes.

notes.trade: Frontier trade post.
notes.missions: Patrol and escort contracts.

name: Gliese 876
description: A red dwarf with a family of giant planets in tight resonance. The road to Fomalhaut starts here.

bodies.name: Gliese 876 b
bodies.description: A massive gas giant in the star's habitable zone.

bodies.name: Resonance Station
bodies.description: A waystation that watches the giant planets wheel in lockstep.

sites.name: Observation Deck
sites.description: Tired crews, a big window, and the last good coffee before Fomalhaut.

notes.bar: The Lockstep — last call before the long jump.

name: Altair
description: A fast-spinning white star, flattened by its own speed. Frontier space.

bodies.name: Altair Waystation
bodies.description: A hardened waystation at the frontier. The dock is always open; the silence is total.

sites.name: Waystation Dock
sites.description: A quiet automated dock. Someone has scratched names and dates into the bulkhead — captains who passed through, some of them long ago.

name: Fomalhaut
description: A young white star circled by a vast dust ring. Few ships make the long jump out here.

bodies.name: Ringwatch
bodies.description: A lonely station on the inner edge of the great dust ring.

sites.name: Ringwatch
sites.description: A handful of watchers studying the ring, and whatever moves inside it.

notes.missions: Ring surveys — strange readings to investigate.

name: Vega
description: A brilliant blue-white star at the edge of charted space. Beyond here, the maps go quiet.

bodies.name: Vega Waystation
bodies.description: The last waystation before the dark. Its log records every ship that goes out, and every one that comes back.

sites.name: Waystation Dock
sites.description: A quiet automated dock. Someone has scratched names and dates into the bulkhead — captains who passed through, some of them long ago.
